title: Mynt's ledger request (mynt.partner_ledger.request.v1)
description: The body of Mynt's POST <base_url>/v1/ledger to a licence provider, signed with Mynt-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of '<t>.<raw body>'> under the firm's ledger secret. Answer 200 with a statement (statement.v1.schema.json) covering every product_id asked for, or an error (error.v1.schema.json): 401 when the signature doesn't verify or is more than 300 seconds old; 400 when the body isn't this shape, its environment isn't the one this deployment serves, or its audience isn't this endpoint's own URL.

request_id.description: Echo it in the statement; a repeated request_id is a replay

environment.description: test is asked of your test endpoint only, live of your live endpoint only. Each deployment knows which it is and refuses the other with 400

product_ids.description: Answer each one: a product you don't know is null with a reason, never left out and never 0

period_end.description: The end of the period Mynt is recording; answer with your books as of now

audience.description: The exact URL Mynt sent this to (<base_url>/v1/ledger). Refuse with 400 unless it's your own endpoint's URL: a request meant for another URL may have been relayed to you
